notes.title: Update 2024.1.0
notes.notes:
TECHNICAL
- Improved script performance, especially when the ideal line is turned ON
- Reduced RAM usage by 15% to 40% (depending on the scene)
- Reduced build size by 120 MB

MULTIPLAYER
- Improved position synchronization in general
- Additionally, improved precision when the vehicle is rotating and better synced vehicle rotation along its axis
- Vehicles should be ghosted in the other vehicle lags and become stationary for a brief moment (when several packets are temporarily lost)
- When loading race fails, the game now returns to the main menu
- Further improvements are yet to come

GRAPHICS
- Added rocks
- Improved skyscrapers on the map "City park"
